# FANN

> FANN designs and builds exhibition stands, events and interior fit-out projects across the UAE. Founded 2021. Based in Al Barsha, Dubai, with its own production workshop in Umm Al Quwain, FANN takes exhibition stands and commercial interiors from design to build and installation under one scoped contract.

FANN (legal name: FANN for Facilities Management Services) is a Dubai design-and-build company serving exhibitors, brands and businesses across the United Arab Emirates. Licensed by Dubai's Department of Economy and Tourism (licence no. 993770).

## Capabilities

- Custom exhibition stands: concept, 3D design, fabrication, graphics, logistics, installation and dismantling
- Modular exhibition stands and country pavilions
- Corporate events: stages, ceremonies and event environments
- Interior fit-out: offices, clinics, retail and commercial interiors, from brief to handover
- In-house production: own workshop in Umm Al Quwain for fabrication and joinery

## Locations

- Head office: Office No. 508, Dusseldorf Business Center, Al Barsha 1, Dubai, UAE
- Production workshop: Umm Al Quwain, UAE

## Venues and shows

Stands delivered at Dubai World Trade Centre (GITEX, Gulfood, Big 5 Global, Automechanika Dubai), ADNEC Abu Dhabi, Dubai Exhibition Centre (Expo City) and other UAE venues.

## Selected projects

- Icons of Porsche festival stand
- Bayara at Gulfood
- Apollo Tyres at Automechanika Dubai
- India Pavilion at Gulfood
- Abbott at Arab Health
- Dubai Properties at Cityscape
- Special Olympics Unified Champion Schools 2025 awarding ceremony
- ADEK National Expression event, Abu Dhabi
